rationale: The bounded user-visible product-semantics change spans three canonical owners and three source paths, warranting small formal artefacts while avoiding full structured delivery because no runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, API, CLI, release, or cross-host impact is supplied. Compact delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are absent; verified change is ineligible because ownership is not singular and propagation is not deterministic.
